config.prefill_wait_metric_definition: Engine steps from request arrival to first scheduler selection in a Prefill batch; queue wait time is measured at schedule() return, before model execution.
config.prefill_total_wait_definition: For every Engine step while a request still has uncached Prompt tokens, count one wait step if it receives no Prefill allocation in that step. This includes initial queueing and between-chunk waits; it excludes a step in which it receives any Prefill allocation.
config.prefill_completion_definition: The first Engine step after which num_cached_tokens reaches num_prompt_tokens. Completion time is measured at the end of that Engine step, after CUDA synchronization.
config.stage_timing_definition: scheduler_schedule_time_ms is CPU wall time spent in Scheduler.schedule(). decode_forward_gpu_time_ms and prefill_forward_gpu_time_ms are CUDA-event elapsed times around ModelRunner.run_model; they cover model forward and logit computation, not tensor preparation or sampling, and are not per-request timings.
